environment.description: Same AWS Step Functions workflow and Lambda code deployed against PostgreSQL 14 on RDS. The database has ALTER TABLE orders ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and ALTER TABLE orders FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY applied. A policy exists: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON orders USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid). The db user 'app_service' is NOT a superuser and NOT the table owner (table owned by 'migrations_admin'), so FORCE RLS applies. The SET app.current_tenant in the connection setup binds the session to the authenticated tenant's UUID before any queries execute. Note: pg_hba.conf restricts 'app_service' connections to the Lambda security group CIDR only.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with RLS FORCE enabled on orders table
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON orders USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid)
config.table_config: ALTER TABLE orders ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE orders FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
config.table_owner: migrations_admin (separate role, not used by application)
config.db_user: app_service - not superuser, not table owner, RLS enforced
config.step_functions: Standard workflow, no input validation on order_id
config.api_gateway: JWT authorizer extracts tenant_id into Step Functions input
config.network: Lambda in VPC, pg_hba.conf restricts app_service to Lambda SG CIDR
